title: Mere hussain ko rote
body:
mere hussain ko rote raho dua dungi
har ek chaahne waale ko bakhswa dungi
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheed e kushtae jor o jafa pe rote hai
jo mere laal ko farshe aza pe rote hai
mai ek roz unhe karbala dikha dungi
mere hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
dilon ka dard labe ilteja pe rakh dena
tamam haajatein farshe aza pe rakh dena
har ek daaman e umeed ko saja dungi
mere hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
in aansuon ke waseele se tum ko chain milay
na koi ranj siwa e ghame hussain milay
ba fazle rab tumhe is khair ki jaza dungi
mere hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
na ro saki jisay jee bhar ke zainab e dilgeer
sada buland rahe shor e matam e shabbir
mai in sadaon mein apni sada mila dungi
mere hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare ashk bahot motabar hai mere liye
yehi to marhame zakhme jigar hai mere liye
rasool ko inhi ashkon ka waasta dungi
mere hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
gulu e khusk pe khanjar pe maine dekha hai
wahin pe laasha e besar bhi maine dekha hai
batao kaise mai karbobala bhula dungi
mere hussain ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaleem tohfa e gham haq ki pursadari hai
jo qaum aaj bhi masroof e aah o zaari hai
usay mai saaya e rehmat mein aasra dungi
mere hussain ko...
author: Kaleem
